subject: MediCore IAM evidence & SSO next steps
messages: Subject: MediCore IAM evidence & SSO next steps

Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: MediCore is evaluating Redwood for synchronous chat and patient-note generation in a controlled environment; security and identity are the gating factors for procurement (SOC 2 status, HIPAA controls, and admin-level access controls). You mentioned a vendor security review and an internal list of IAM items you need to validate.

Below are the items we committed to provide and the asks from your side. Proposed owners and a rough timeline are included so we can keep procurement moving.

What Redwood will deliver (by EOD Fri 2026-05-15 unless we hear otherwise):
- Completed evidence checklist (Reqs_Auth-Evidence_Checklist.xlsx) — includes pointers to artifacts. (Owner: Monica)
- SAML/SSO config summary and sample metadata (SAML-metadata.xml — stub attached) — endpoints and IdP requirements (Owner: Grace)
- SCIM provisioning details: supported attributes, provisioning flows, and sample endpoints (SCIM-endpoints.csv stub) (Owner: Grace)
- RBAC matrix and admin roles doc — show admin separation, console capabilities, and approval flows (Owner: Monica)
- Notes on audit logging and retention, plus how we surface user change events via the Console and API (Owner: Monica)

Requests from MediCore (please confirm items below and approximate ETA):
- Confirm preferred SSO binding (HTTP-Redirect vs HTTP-POST) and whether you'll provide SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flow (Liam / IAM team)
- Provide contact for SCIM testing and a test account (Aisha / IAM team)
- Any minimum retention or log export requirements for HIPAA audits (security@medicorehealth.com)

Next steps / Proposed timeline:
- 2026-05-13: Redwood sends checklist + SAML metadata + SCIM stub (today)
- 2026-05-14: MediCore to return preferred SSO binding and a test account for SCIM test
- 2026-05-18: Technical call (30 min) with Grace and your IAM engineer to run through SSO/SCIM configuration and a short demo of the admin console (I can set this up)

If anything here is off, please flag. Grace and Monica are copied and will pick up the artifacts and any follow-ups.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping things moving.

—Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: MediCore IAM evidence & SSO next steps

Sean / Grace / Monica —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick replies inline and a couple of items attached for your intake:

- Preferred SSO binding: we primarily use SP-initiated SAML with HTTP-POST. We can support IdP-initiated for edge cases but will test SP-first.
- SCIM testing: Aisha (copied) will be the point for provisioning. We can spin up a sandbox account by Friday; please send instructions to her.
- Log retention: for HIPAA audits we need at least 7 years of user access logs; for now we need confirmation on export formats and whether logs can be pushed to our SIEM.

I've attached the SAML metadata from our IdP (SAML-metadata.xml) and a short CSV with the SCIM endpoints we'll test against (SCIM-endpoints.csv). We won't send the full questionnaire yet — procurement will load that into DocuSign once SOC 2 paperwork is confirmed.

Let's do the tech call on 2026-05-18 at 10:00 AM PT; that works for Aisha and our IAM engineer.

Thanks —
Liam
Director of IT Security | MediCore Health
liam.oconnell@medicorehealth.com

Attachments: SAML-metadata.xml (attached), SCIM-endpoints.csv (attached)
Subject: Re: MediCore IAM evidence & SSO next steps

Liam / Aisha —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. I'll take point for the SCIM and SAML technical review and prepare a short demo focused on the admin console RBAC and the provisioning flow.

For the SCIM sandbox: Aisha, could you confirm the test account username you'd like us to use (email or sAMAccountName)? Once confirmed we'll run a provisioning dry-run and share a test log.

Regarding logs/export: we support exporting audit logs as NDJSON or CSV and can ship them to an S3 bucket or push to a supported SIEM via our event-streaming connector. Monica — can you add a one-page note on retention policy and Data Processing Addendum specifics for HIPAA? I'll include that in the package we send to procurement.

I'll also prepare a minimal RBAC matrix screenshot from the console so your security team can see admin separation and super-admin controls. If you want, we can restrict the demo to redacted patient data and walkthrough safe-mode prompts for generation.

Confirming the tech call: 2026-05-18 10:00 AM PT (2026-05-18T17:00:00Z). I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

—Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.inference
